cases.sentence: На ___ правления Кира, царя Персии , Даниилу (называемому также Белтешаццаром) было дано откровение.
cases.explain: «третий год» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, even a great warfare. He understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

cases.sentence: Его весть истинна и относится к ___ .
cases.explain: «великой войне» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, even a great warfare. He understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

cases.sentence: Я не ел ___, мясо и вино не касались моих губ, и я не умащался благовонными маслами, пока не прошли три недели.
cases.explain: «вкусной пищи» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I ate no pleasant bread. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

cases.sentence: Затем я услышал, как он говорит, и слушая его, упал ничком в ___.
cases.explain: «глубокий обморок» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Yet I heard the voice of his words. When I heard the voice of his words, then I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

cases.sentence: Но князь ___ противостоял мне двадцать один день, и Михаил, единственный великий князь , пришел мне на помощь; я оставался там с царями Персии .
cases.explain: «Персидского царства» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me because I remained there with the kings of Persia.
